Hi Susan / Soojin — attaching the remediation package per Soojin's timeline. Summary below and attachment index. Attachment stub names are included; full zip (remediation_evidence.zip) contains exported artifacts and screenshots.

Executive summary (short):
- Exception 1 (Access control — privileged account onboarding): Issue identified in Q3 2025. Management response: tightened onboarding workflow, MFA enforcement on admin role, automated access reviews. Status: Remediated and validated. Evidence: INFRA-4231 (Jira), access_review_2026-02.csv (snapshot), iam-policy-attachments.txt.
- Exception 2 (Monitoring alert escalation): Issue where some alerts were not routed to on-call. Management response: updated alerting runbook, added email+pager escalation policy, created synthetic monitors for critical endpoints. Status: Mitigating controls in place; verification tests completed on 2026-02-20. Evidence: SEC-511 (Jira), synthetic-monitor-test-results-20260220.log.
- Exception 3 (Backup key rotation gap): Root cause traced to a manual step in the key-rotation playbook that was missed. Management response: automated rotation via KMS job, added post-rotation verification. Status: Remediated; proof-of-rotation provided. Evidence: INFSEC-332 (Jira), kms-rotation-audit-20260215.json, backup-rotation-screenshots.png.

Attachment index (in remediation_evidence.zip):
- jira_export.csv (rows: INFRA-4231, SEC-511, INFSEC-332 and linked PRs)
- iam/access_review_2026-02.csv
- logs/synthetic-monitor-test-results-20260220.log

- screenshots/backup-rotation-screenshots.png
- management_response_summary.pdf (narratives + closure dates)
- SOC2_TypeII_2025-07-01_to_2026-01-31.pdf
